KEEP THE FIELD NAMES EXACTLY AS THE ENDPOINT RETURNS THEM - then the same toItem() in js/api.js normalises this file and a live response through the same code path, which is the only way the offline path can be trusted to behave like the live one. Renaming the fields here to match your Item type defeats the whole point.
//noImageUrls: Do NOT keep remote image URLs. They would need the network, and a catalogue that needs the network to draw its pictures is not an offline catalogue. Leave the image field out; toItem() should yield null and render.js falls back to images/placeholder.svg.
//oneOddRow: Worth doing on purpose: leave ONE row missing an optional field. It exercises your null-handling with real data instead of only in theory, and it is where most students discover their card renders the word 'undefined'.
